title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Refinance Seasoning and Rate Reduction Refinance Limits
content:
Refinances under the VA Home Loan Guaranty are bound by five program figures: the calendar days from the first payment due date of the loan being refinanced that must pass before the new loan closes; the monthly payments on the loan being refinanced that must have been made before the new loan closes; the months within which the fees and closing costs of a rate reduction refinance must be recouped from the payment savings; the minimum interest rate reduction, in percentage points, for a fixed-to-fixed rate reduction refinance; and the years beyond the original loan term by which a rate reduction refinance may extend the term.

## Figures by program

| Program | Seasoning (calendar days from the first payment due date of the loan refinanced) | Monthly payments made on the loan refinanced | Recoupment period (months) | Minimum fixed-to-fixed rate reduction (percentage points) | Most term extension beyond the original term (years) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| VA Interest Rate Reduction Refinance Loan (IRRRL) | 210 | 6 | 36 | 0.5 | 10 |
| VA Manufactured Home Loan | 210 | 6 | 36 | 0.5 | 10 |
| VA Purchase Loan (10% or More Down) | 210 | 6 | 36 | 0.5 | 10 |
| VA Purchase Loan (5% to Less Than 10% Down) | 210 | 6 | 36 | 0.5 | 10 |
| VA Purchase Loan (Less Than 5% Down) | 210 | 6 | 36 | 0.5 | 10 |
| VA Cash-Out Refinance Loan | 210 | 6 | 36 | 0.5 | 10 |
| Native American Direct Loan (NADL) | 210 | 6 | 36 | 0.5 | 10 |

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical rate reduction refinance of a fixed rate of 6.75 percent to a fixed rate of 6.25 percent lowers the rate by 0.5 points, which meets the 0.5-point minimum; a reduction to 6.30 percent lowers it by 0.45 points, which does not. A hypothetical original term of 20 years may be extended to at most 30 years, which is 10 years beyond it.
